errors.evidence: The x-axis is labeled with numbers 10 through 20. Interpreting these as the years 2010 to 2020 is an assumption not explicitly stated in the figure's labels.
The red line (EU-27) does not have a peak at x=17 (2017). It continues to rise until the end of the observed period at x=20, which is the highest point on the line.
The final value for the red line (EU-27) at x=20 is approximately 90, not 92.
